bioEn: Robson leads the development team and writes most of the devlogs. When not battling Unity physics bugs, he's probably debugging why 1 doesn't equal 1 or wondering why the player is bouncing like a pogo stick.
bioMi: Ko Robson te kaihautū i te rōpū whanaketanga. Kāore ia i te pakanga i ngā hapa ahupūngao o Unity, kei te patuiro ia i te take kāore 1 e ōrite ki 1.
